title: The idea of Tollgate in four steps
desc: Tests are written first and say what done means. They are locked on the server, where the AI cannot reach. The AI builds and may try again, but cannot move the goal. The tests decide, and only a pass goes in.

nodes.text:
Write the tests
They say what done means

Lock them
On the server, out of
the AI's reach

The AI builds
It can try again.
It cannot move the goal.

The tests decide
Only a pass goes in
